prize.quote: The prize amount was not adopted: the grand prize is conditional on a 57-hit streak and the rules sections holding the figure were not read.

summary: Confirmed free entry and US eligibility, but the grand prize requires a 57-hit streak — a conditional jackpot, not a prize table. The season also ends with the 2026 regular season, so it is not open now.
